title: Captaincy Under Uncertainty: Which Decisions Matter Most for Chennai Super Kings?
dek: Which decisions matter most for an Chennai Super Kings captain? The franchise's captaincy record shows how leadership and results have moved together.
excerpt: Chennai Super Kings have had a series of captains. The records that can be credited to this franchise alone show how much results have varied from one leader to the next.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: {{ev:cap-top}} has the longest franchise-only record: {{ev:cap-top-n}} matches at a win rate of {{ev:cap-top-pct}}. MS Dhoni captained CSK for longer, but his record in the dataset combines franchises, so it is not compared.
Across all seasons CSK have won {{ev:cap-team}} of matches with a result.

sections.heading: Decisions Under Uncertainty
body: A T20 captain makes a handful of decisions that move win probability: the toss choice, the bowling order, the use of the impact substitute and when to change the field. Most are made with incomplete information.
CricField's captaincy records list {{ev:cap-n}} captains for Chennai Super Kings. The franchise has won {{ev:cap-team}} of its matches with a result across all seasons.

sections.heading: The Records
body: Among captains whose records cover CSK alone, {{ev:cap-top}} led in {{ev:cap-top-n}} matches at a win rate of {{ev:cap-top-pct}}. The table lists every captain with a franchise-only record of five or more matches.
Some captains, including MS Dhoni and Suresh Raina, also led other franchises; their records in the dataset combine teams, so they are not compared here.

sections.heading: Which Decisions Matter Most
body: Elsewhere in this series, wickets in hand and death bowling show large measurable effects on results, while the toss is a small edge across the league. Those are the decisions most worth a captain's attention.
For CSK, captaincy can be judged on those decisions rather than on the win rate alone, which depends heavily on the squad.

sections.heading: Captains Inherit Their Squads
body: A captain's win rate is mostly a measure of the squad he was given. Separating leadership from talent needs decision-level data, such as bowling changes and field settings, that public records do not contain.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Judge the Decisions, Not the Record
body: Chennai Super Kings should evaluate captains on a short list of measurable decisions, reviewed after each match, rather than on win rate.
Over a season, that review would show which captaincy habits are worth keeping.
